citations.assessment: The first attribution is to Ammi bar Chiyya and the second gives Avin bar Kahana. The exchange concerns food joined by liquid.
The base text has Assi bar Chiyya in a separate idolatry passage. The name resemblance alone does not imply one reading is an error.
